body:
Adds an optional case-insensitive `search` query parameter to `GET /api/v1/items/` and a search box on the Items page that filters the list through the API.

- Backend: `backend/app/api/routes/items.py` (`read_items`) applies a title filter (`icontains`, autoescaped) combined with the existing owner filter.
- Frontend: `frontend/src/routes/_layout/items.tsx` adds a `data-testid="item-search"` input; empty-result state says "No items match your search".
- Client type updated: `frontend/src/client/types.gen.ts`.
title: feat(items): search items by title
